audit.why: 48.44% over 4170 games with the packet chart giving Akali 1-2, Syndra 3-5, Akali 6+. Tricky 7/10 is right: Syndra out-ranges Akali by 250-375 and her stun is the only thing that stops the shroud pattern.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[1] described the 3-5 window on the level-2 row and whys[3] talked about level 6 on the levels 4-5 row.
audit.why: Rows must describe their own level. Syndra has no stun until 3 (Scatter the Weak), and her 4-5 edge is Force of Will's 925 range, not the ultimate.
audit.corrected: Level 2 stays Akali's because E is not learned; 4-5 is Syndra's on W range and Transcendent true damage; 6 flips back to Akali.
sources: brief enemyKit W range 925, P Transcendent trueDamage

audit.whatIsWrong: Unleashed Power was called a 'long-range execute from outside your engage range'; no cooldown numbers anywhere.
audit.why: Unleashed Power is 675 range — identical to Perfect Execution and shorter than Akali's 825 E. The real spacing problem is Force of Will at 925 and Dark Sphere at 800. The decisive cooldown is Scatter the Weak: 15 seconds flat at every rank, 650 range, and it only stuns through a Dark Sphere — so the punish window never shortens as she levels.
audit.corrected: Count her E at a flat 15s and stay off the line between Syndra and any placed sphere; Dark Sphere's 7s flat cooldown means she always has an orb, so the stun is the timer that matters.
sources: brief enemyKit Q/W/E/R ranges and cooldowns
brief ownerKit E range 825, R range 675

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization said nothing about Transcendent making resistances the wrong purchase.
audit.why: missingInteractions flags resistances-invalidated: upgraded Force of Will deals bonus true damage, so stacking MR does not answer her poke. Zhonya's/stopwatch does.
audit.corrected: Buy Zhonya's for the ult window rather than raw MR.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart disagreed between layers on all seven rows: full read Syndra/Syndra/Skill/Skill/Syndra/Skill/Syndra, content read Akali/Akali/Syndra/Syndra/Akali/Akali/Akali.
audit.why: The content layer matches the packet chart; the full layer does not, so the page renders two answers per row.
audit.corrected: Flip all seven full-layer sides to the content values.

audit.why: Packet flagged 'Dark Spheres' as a suspect name. It is the correct ability Dark Sphere in the plural — a false positive, no change made.

edits.before: He pokes until you shroud, then the lane belongs to the smoke — trade in obscured windows and energy-walk the rest.
edits.after: She pokes at 800 range until you shroud, then the lane belongs to the smoke — trade in her sphere gaps and walk the rest.

edits.before: Syndra wins by landing Scatter the Weak (Stun), denying your pattern, and owning the spacing war until your tempo starves.
edits.after: Syndra wins by knocking a sphere through you with Scatter the Weak, stunning you out of the shroud window, then executing with Unleashed Power.

edits.before: Q the wave edge and his toes — the energy crunch is real, so every kama needs to farm AND poke at once.
edits.after: Q the wave edge and her toes — Dark Sphere is a flat 7s, so farm on it and step up in the gap between spheres.

edits.before: Shroud online: the trade pattern is Q-auto, shroud the answer, Q again from the smoke. Most mids lose this exchange.
edits.after: Shroud is online but she has spheres now — Scatter the Weak stuns through them on a flat 15s timer. Shroud it, don't eat it.

edits.before: Passive-weave every trade: spell, walk out of the ring, auto the edge — the energy refunds pay the whole lane.
edits.after: Force of Will flings a sphere or a minion from 925 — she out-ranges you badly, so trade only once she has spent it.

edits.before: Perfect Execution online — the double-dash R turns half-health mages into clean-up duty. Look for the all-in.
edits.after: Unleashed Power executes from 675 and Scatter the Weak sets it up — never stand at ult range while her E is up.

edits.before: - Syndra Scatter the Weak (Stun): matchup-defining — The QE stun cone starts every kill combo — stay off the line between her and her orbs. Step up only on its downtime. - Budget W Twilight Shroud for emergencies and the R for opportunities — never swap them.
edits.after: - Scatter the Weak is 15 seconds at every rank — it never gets shorter, and it is the only window that matters. - Dark Sphere is a flat 7s, so she always has an orb up; count the stun, not the poke. - Shroud her E line, never her Q.

edits.before: If Syndra gets a kill, the lane gets honest — give Scatter the Weak (Stun) extra room and farm it back. Two kills: stop dueling your tilt — farm with Q range and stay relevant through shroud picks.
edits.after: If Syndra gets a kill her spheres do the rest — stay off the line between her and any orb she has placed. Two kills: farm at 550, shroud the E, and take fights only while Unleashed Power is down.

edits.before: Carry through deletions — one carry per fight, every fight; the shroud buys the time and the resets pay the exit.
edits.after: Syndra needs you standing in her spheres, so enter from an angle she has not pre-placed — shroud the setup, E-reset out.

edits.before: Ahead, erase the lane: shroud every contact, all-in the whiffs, and roam with R banked — fed Akali turns mid into a no-cast zone for Syndra.
edits.after: Ahead, take her range away: shroud onto her sphere line, all-in every whiffed Scatter the Weak, and spend R on a kill rather than on chip.

edits.before: Start Doran's Shield or Ring + pots. Riftmaker or Stormsurge-line first, Sorcerer's/Mercs, then Zhonya's into burst, Rabadon's after.
edits.after: Start Doran's Shield + pots. Riftmaker or Stormsurge first, Sorcerer's, then Zhonya's — upgraded Force of Will is true damage, so buy the stopwatch, not raw MR.

edits.before: Her sphere-stacking snowball catches up by levels 3-5, letting her poke-into-stun you before your combo lands
edits.after: Level 2 is still yours — she has no Scatter the Weak until 3, so her spheres are poke you can simply walk out of

edits.before: Her ranged execute threat keeps growing as she approaches her ultimate spike, tipping the mid-lane phase her way
edits.after: Scatter the Weak lands at 3 and stuns through any sphere she has placed, so her all-in beats yours for the first time

edits.before: Both champions gain a lot at 6, but her stun-into-execute combo is the scarier all-in if she's positioned it correctly
edits.after: At 4-5 Force of Will reaches 925 and adds true damage once upgraded, so she wins the spacing war before your ult arrives

edits.before: Unleashed Power is a long-range execute that can one-shot you from outside your engage range if she's landed her Scatter the Weak stun, so respect her spacing hard around 6.
edits.after: Unleashed Power fires every sphere she owns at 675 range and executes low targets, and Scatter the Weak's flat 15-second stun is the setup — so respect her orb placement hard at 6.

edits.before: Respect her space hard once she's got orbs stacked — Unleashed Power is a long-range execute that can delete you from outside your combo range if she lands the stun first. Don't walk up blind; wait for her spheres to be on cooldown or bait them out with wave management before committing. Level 6 is genuinely dangerous for you if you misplay the spacing.
edits.after: Respect her space once orbs are placed — Unleashed Power throws all of them at 675 range and executes, and Scatter the Weak is what sets it up. Don't walk up blind: her E is a flat 15 seconds at every rank, so bait it, count it, and step in on the downtime. Upgraded Force of Will deals true damage, so magic resist won't save you from the misplay — spacing will.

notes: Full-layer level chart disagreed with the content layer on all seven rows; content matched the packet, so only the full sides are flipped, proposed as one atomic group with the two rating changes. Corrected the recurring claim that Unleashed Power out-ranges Akali's engage — it is 675, the same as Perfect Execution and shorter than her 825 E; her actual range advantage is Force of Will at 925 and Dark Sphere at 800. Added the resistances-invalidated point to itemization. 'Dark Spheres' in the early text is a packet false positive, not a wrong name. Several full-layer fields still use male pronouns for Syndra (winCon uses none, but breakdown.wave, tradeGood, tradeBad, dosFull[1].d and phases[5].why all say 'his'); those are Akali-generic templates and the pronoun fix alone would not de-templatise them, so they are recorded here rather than edited.
